data.sub: Haryana Board 12th supplementary result declare hua.

chat.say: Papa second chance mein 12th clear ho gayi!
Chal ab bina time waste kiye college dhoondh!

data.asar: Pass ho gaye to jaldi se college admission lo.
data.caption:
Haryana Board 12th supplementary result declare ho chuka hai! 📋✨

• Haryana Board ne 12th compartment exam ka result jaari kiya
• Regular students ka pass percentage 68.32% raha
• Open school category mein 52.10% bachhe pass huye

Aakhri mauke ne poora saal barbaad hone se bacha liya! 😅🎓

Apne us dost ko tag karo jiska 12th ka re-exam tha! 👇
